p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-a9a71a13.py'; src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r, c) not in seen:
                todo = [(r, c)]
                seen.add((r, c))
                comp = []
                while todo:
                    y, x = todo.pop()
                    comp.append((y, x))
                    for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                        for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                            q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                            if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and grid[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                                seen.add(q)
                                todo.append(q)
                comps.append(comp)
    # Select the large component in the bottom-right, formed by diagonally adjacent motifs.
    comp = max(comps, key=lambda z: (max(r for r, c in z), max(c for r, c in z)))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in comp), max(r for r, c in comp)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in comp), max(c for r, c in comp)
    cells = set(comp)
    return [[grid[r][c] if (r, c) in cells else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''; open(p,'w').write(src); print(transform if False else p)
